channel.title: Comments on: Blog Usability: Pogosticking Revisited
channel.description: Instant Usability & Web Standards — static archive

item.title: By: Stephanie
item.dc:creator: Stephanie
item.description: Hmm, I would have to agree for both sides but mainly as a user. I would prefer not to implement pogosticking because of the frustration to the web user by having to click here and click there over and over.

item.title: By: Henry madsen
item.dc:creator: Henry madsen
item.description:
Yes right, nothing is bad or wrong untill overused. Anything which cross its limit and is over-used either create problems, or bad for all! Anyways, pogosticking is good in lots of contexts.

regards.

item.title: By: justaddwater.dk | Blog Usability: We dumped our archives
item.dc:creator: justaddwater.dk | Blog Usability: We dumped our archives

item.title: By: Christopher Fahey
item.dc:creator: Christopher Fahey
item.description: I wouldn’t want to create the impression that pogosticking is inherently wrong. It can be fine in lots of contexts. It’s only bad when it’s used excessively and/or where another option (such contextual navs/links) would be better.
